info.name: Flight Booking API
info.description:
Every endpoint of the Flight Search, Booking and Ticketing API, in the order of a demo.

1. Start the stack and seed demo data: `pnpm bootstrap`, then `pnpm dev` (API on :3001).
2. Import this collection and `local.postman_environment.json`, select the environment.
3. Run the whole collection, or send requests one by one from the top.

Sessions are cookies: each folder signs in first, and Postman keeps the cookie. State-changing requests carry `X-Requested-With` (CSRF), added by the collection's script.

exec: // The API refuses state-changing requests without this header (CSRF protection).
const iso = (offset, hourUtc) => { const d = new Date(Date.now() + offset * 86400000); d.setUTCHours(hourUtc, 0, 0, 0); return d.toISOString(); };

The Catalog applies its schedule rules; Inventory gets both cabins in the same transaction.
Applies to new searches and bookings; existing bookings keep their fare snapshot.
One flight per chosen weekday (1 = Monday); local time stays fixed across DST.
